Container.Name: caddy-ui-frontend
Container.Overview:
Web interface for caddy/ui. Manage Caddyfiles, routes, TLS certificates, logs, and metrics. Requires caddy-ui-backend and an existing Caddy server.
Select the same user-defined Docker bridge network for both UI containers and Caddy. You can use an existing custom bridge network: change Network Type in both templates to that network. If you need a new network, run "docker network create caddy-ui" in the Unraid terminal before installing and select "Custom: caddy-ui". Install and start caddy-ui-backend first, keeping both UI container names unchanged. The frontend connects to caddy-ui-backend:3001 through Docker DNS; the default bridge network does not provide this name resolution.
Set External UI URL on the backend to the exact browser address, normally http://YOUR-UNRAID-IP:9877. Then open this WebUI, create the administrator, save the recovery key, and discover or add your Caddy server. Keep the installation private until administrator setup is complete.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Browser-facing port. If changed, update External UI URL on the backend to match.

Config.Name: Trusted upstream proxies
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated IP addresses or narrow CIDRs of reverse proxies in front of this UI. Leave empty for direct access. Used to preserve client addresses and separate rate limits.
